name: Aly Gonzales / AGENCY818
summary: Pink, cream and serif. Single-take talking heads, no music, a different graphic treatment on every beat.

pacing.punchInRule: Alternate at sentence ends only, and only when Claude does the cut.

rules: Vary the mix: every beat gets a different treatment, never the same graphic type twice in a row.
Retakes: when the same idea is said twice, keep only the last take.
On-screen hook text never repeats a line said later in the video.
If the clip was trimmed by hand, the cuts are final. Only add graphics, sound and captions.
Graphics appear on a spoken word, never in silence. No title-only pop-ins.
Cards are sized to their content. Text stays off the face: cards above the head, big text on the chest, captions low.
No em dashes in on-screen text. Use the speaker's own words.
Real recorded sound effects only, one per visible event, under the voice.
Export at the recorded resolution and frame rate.
sources: Seeded from the approved talking-head edits (founder_mom_day1_2026_11_03_v2, founder_mom_tiktok_2026_11_03_v11).
